phases.objective: Ensure the canonical baseline creates platform_contract_surfaces with every column required by migration 041 and the knowledge-surface runtime before the ordered migration replay starts.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact local Git checkout applies schema.sql and the migration chain ordered by numeric prefix with filename tie-breaker in disposable MariaDB.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Migration 041 can add business_type_scope and execute its updates without an unknown platform_contract_surfaces table, while the generator remains schema-only and fail-closed.
steps: The canonical baseline declares platform_contract_surfaces with the runtime-facing identity, scope, lifecycle, authority, adapter, file, and folder columns.
Migration 041 remains idempotent and adds business_type_scope after surface_scope.
The manifest requires platform_contract_surfaces in the runtime support contract and validates its baseline columns.
The generator reports the platform_contract_surfaces baseline contract in plan evidence before disposable MariaDB starts.
The regression suite covers the baseline-to-migration-041 ordering and the schema-only safety contract.
No Production database, provider, credential, or data-copy path is introduced.
assertions: schema.sql contains the platform_contract_surfaces baseline table definition.
The runtime role requires platform_contract_surfaces and the support-table census includes it.
The generator fails closed when the platform_contract_surfaces table or any required baseline column is missing.
The generator emits the platform_contract_surfaces baseline contract in plan evidence.
Production mutation, provider mutation, data copy, and force-push remain forbidden.
